name: RideLock
description: A lock screen for riding in a jacket: buttons do nothing until you press the lit ones in turn. Relocks itself, and warns if something drains the battery behind it.

configFields.label: Unlock sequence
configFields.description: Buttons to press in turn, e.g. L1 R1 R2 L2 L1 R1. Use both sides, never the same button twice in a row. Longer is safer.
configFields.default: L1 R1 R2 L2 L1 R1
configFields.validationMessage: 2 to 8 of L1, L2, R1, R2, separated by spaces.

configFields.label: Relock after
configFields.description: Put the lock back up this long after unlocking. 0 keeps it off until you open RideLock again.

configFields.label: Lock at start-up
configFields.description: Show the lock as soon as the watch starts, so a reboot or a power-on inside a sleeve comes up locked.

configFields.label: Notifications while locked
configFields.description: Let phone notifications appear over the lock screen.

configFields.label: Drain alert above
configFields.description: Vibrate if the battery current stays above this while locked, which means something (a GPS activity) is running behind the lock. 0 turns the alert off.

configFields.label: Drain alert after
configFields.description: How long the current must stay high before the alert.

configFields.label: Show battery current
configFields.description: Show the measured battery current on the lock screen (an experiment aid).
